packed_luma.luma: Pillow RGB→L on decoded native pixels

method.width: Perpendicular profile of saved-paper luma minus rendered luma, bilinear sample every 0.125 px over ±10 px. The nearest qualifying peak within the guide search radius is located by maximum drop; width is distance between the first half-peak crossings, linearly interpolated.
method.ruling_exclusions: Require peak drop ≥25, paper luma ≥150, and local 21-pixel vertical median paper luma minus paper luma ≤12 at the peak.
method.edges: 15 evenly spaced interior cross-sections of each of nine named connector segments, avoiding arrowheads, corners and labels. Matching named segments on the two renders have independent endpoint coordinates.
method.writing: Unchanged code rows (1)–(9). Within each glyph layout box, skeletonize pixels with paper-to-output drop ≥25. Take single-stroke interior skeleton points (2 neighbors, at least 5 points in ±3 px, no branch/end there, covariance major/minor ≥4). Retain points at least 3 px apart. Use local PCA tangent for the perpendicular profile.
method.aggregate: Take the median of retained widths per segment/row, then the median across the nine group medians. Peak drop is aggregated the same way. This does not weigh long lines more heavily.
